tools.name: make_part
tools.description: Build, check and price a custom 3D-printed part from exact sizes (mm): plate with holes, L-bracket, spacer/standoff, washer, or box with lid. Shows the part in 3D with its price and an Order button. Sizes left out use sensible defaults. Use again with new sizes or options when the customer asks for

tools.name: price_file
tools.description: Price the customer's 3D file (STL, 3MF, STEP or OBJ) and show it in ply's card. Without a file, shows the card with an upload button (with sourceUrl: the model page to download it from). In ChatGPT, pass a file the customer attached. Pass `path` (from an earlier result) to change options for a file

tools.name: price_model_link
tools.description: Show a 3D model's page in ply's card with an upload box: the customer opens the link, downloads the file (STL, 3MF, STEP or OBJ) and drops it in for an instant price. ply doesn't download models from any site itself.

tools.name: find_models
tools.description: Search Printables for ready-made 3D models. Returns titles, designers and page links; the customer downloads their pick and drops it into ply's card.

tools.name: recommend_material
tools.description: Run ply's material advisor ("Help me choose" on plyparts.com) for a part: it may ask up to 2 questions about how the part is used, then recommends a process, material, color and strength. Give either the part's ply `path` (a file) or its template and sizes (a built part).

tools.name: order_part
tools.description: Put a part into a ply cart and get the link to finish the order on plyparts.com (shipping, payment, engineer review). Nothing is charged here. For a built part pass the same template, sizes and options; for a file pass its path and options.

tools.name: price_cart
tools.description: Price a cart of several different parts at once (built parts from sizes and/or the customer's files, each with its own options and quantity). ply's card shows them in a grid with each part's picture, quantity, price and the total, and an Order button for all of them. Call again with the whole update

tools.name: order_cart
tools.description: Put every part from price_cart into one ply cart and get the link to finish the order on plyparts.com (shipping, payment, engineer review). Pass the same parts list. Nothing is charged here.

tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: The materials, colors and strength levels ply prints custom parts in, with what each material is good for.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: order_part, order_cart · Private data: price_file, price_model_link, recommend_material, order_part, price_cart · Public sink: price_file, price_model_link · Destructive: recommend_material.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: order_part, order_cart · Private data: price_file, price_model_link, recommend_material, order_part, price_cart · Public sink: price_file, price_model_link · Destructive: recommend_material

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
